headline: Attacks flare between the U.S. and Iran after a monthlong pause
context: U.S. threats erupt into attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran retaliates against U.S. targets in the United Arab Emirates and Jordan in the first exchange of fire since July 29.
